subject: Mobile Development
title: Push Notifications: How They Really Work
description: A quick, practical guide to Push Notifications: How They Really Work.

hook.text: Your phone buzzes with a notification. But the app wasn't even running. How?

buildup.text: A server sends the message to Apple or Google's push service, not directly to your phone.

discovery.text: Your phone maintains one persistent connection to the push service, saving battery.

twist.text: The app developer never knows your IP address. The push service is the middleman.

climax.text: Push notifications are why apps feel alive even when they're not running.

punchline.text: One connection delivers all your notifications.

quiz.question: How do push notifications reach your phone?
options: Through Apple or Google's centralized push service
The app runs constantly in background
